[[Zalnax]] is a ranger boss found in [[Vloxen Excavations]]: Level 2.

==Locations==
*[[Depths of Tyria]]
**{{NPC location|Vloxen Excavations}} (level 2, southwestern corner)

==Skills==
18 [[Expertise]] in [[Hard mode]]
*{{Skill icon|Disrupting Accuracy}}
*{{Skill icon|Distracting Shot}}
*{{Skill icon|Needling Shot}}
*{{Skill icon|Poison Arrow}} ([[elite]])
*{{Skill icon|Troll Unguent}}
*{{Skill icon|Whirling Defense}}

==Items dropped==
*[[Weaver Leg]]
*[[Xalnax's Destiny]] ([[unique]])

==Notes==
*Since Zalnax is on the second level of the dungeon, the quest [[Dredging the Depths]] is required to access him.
{{anomaly|Although this boss is named Zalnax, his unique weapon and the [[Panicked Stone Summit Dwarf|Panicked Stone Summit Dwarves]] that run away from him refer to him as "Xalnax".}}
